---
title: "Does DBH growth data largely reflect the same trajectories as basal diameter?"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false

document_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
	basename(knitr::current_input())
)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	fig.path = file.path("figures", document_name, "")
)

set.seed(as.numeric(Sys.Date()))

ggplot2::theme_set(ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 15))
```

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("patchwork")

clean_data <- read_rds(here::here(
	"data",
	"derived",
	"data_cleaned.rds"
)) |>
	mutate(
		forest_type = case_when(
			grepl("logged", forest_type) ~ "Logged",
			grepl("primary", forest_type) ~ "Old-growth"
		)
	)
```


```{r}
pal <-
	c("Logged" = "#e69f00", "Old-growth" = "#009e73")

sample_sizes <-
	clean_data |>
	summarise(
		dbase_n = sum(is.finite(years) & is.finite(dbase_mean) & dbase_mean > 0),
		dbh_n = sum(is.finite(years) & is.finite(dbh_mean) & dbh_mean > 0),
		.by = forest_type
	)

p1 <-
	clean_data |>
	ggplot(aes(y = log(dbase_mean), x = years, colour = forest_type)) +
	geom_point(alpha = 0.25, shape = 20, colour = "grey") +
	theme(legend.position = "none") +
	geom_smooth(
		method = "gam",
		formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs", k = 3),
		method.args = list(method = "REML", gamma = 1.5)
	) +
	labs(
		x = "Years since first measurment",
		y = "log Basal diameter (mm)"
	) +
	facet_wrap(~forest_type) +
	scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
	geom_text(
		data = sample_sizes,
		aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = paste0("n = ", dbase_n)),
		inherit.aes = FALSE,
		hjust = 1.1,
		vjust = -0.5
	)

p2 <-
	clean_data |>
	ggplot(aes(y = log(dbh_mean), x = years, colour = forest_type)) +
	geom_point(alpha = 0.25, shape = 20, colour = "grey") +
	theme(legend.position = "none") +
	geom_smooth(
		method = "gam",
		formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs", k = 3),
		method.args = list(method = "REML", gamma = 1.5)
	) +
	labs(
		x = "Years since first measurment",
		y = "log Diameter at breast height (mm)"
	) +
	scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
	facet_wrap(~forest_type) +
	geom_text(
		data = sample_sizes,
		aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = paste0("n = ", dbh_n)),
		inherit.aes = FALSE,
		hjust = 1.1,
		vjust = -0.5
	)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10

p1 / p2 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
```

Seedling (a) basal diameter and (b) diameter at breast height (DBH) over time in logged and old-growth forests. Points show individual measurements; lines show generalized additive model fits, with shaded 95% confidence intervals. Sample sizes indicate the number of plotted measurements in each panel.


```{r}
clean_data |>
	filter(
		is.na(survival) | survival != 0,
		!is.na(dbase_mean) | !is.na(dbh_mean)
	) |>
	summarise(
		total_entries = n(),
		across(
			c(dbase_mean, dbh_mean),
			list(
				missing = \(x) sum(is.na(x)),
				proportion = \(x) mean(is.na(x))
			)
		)
	)
```
